perf.summary: Avoid recomputing Math.Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) and re-walking the adjacency list; fold dp1 computation into the existing child loop of DfsMatching.
perf.currentCost: DfsMatching first loop computes dp0[u] += Math.Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) over all children, then FindMaxMatchingCandidate walks the same adjacency list AGAIN recomputing Math.Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) for every child. Two passes over head/to/next (extra pointer-chasing/cache misses) plus a redundant Max per edge.
perf.proposedChange: The candidate term simplifies: dp0[u] - Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) + dp0[v] + edgeWeight[e] = dp0[u] + (dp0[v] - Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) + edgeWeight[e]). Since dp0[u] is constant across candidates, in the first loop accumulate maxExtra = Math.Max(maxExtra, dp0[v] - Math.Max(dp0[v],dp1[v]) + edgeWeight[e]); then dp1[u] = dp0[u] + Math.Max(0, maxExtra). Removes the second adjacency walk entirely.
perf.rationale: One pass instead of two over the edge list halves pointer-chasing through next[] (the main cache-miss source in tree DP) and removes one Math.Max per edge. dp0[u] is loop-invariant once the loop finishes, so factoring it out is exact.
perf.risk: maxCand starts at 0 (empty matching at u), so the fused form must keep dp1[u] = dp0[u] + Math.Max(0, maxExtra); for a leaf maxExtra stays at a sentinel <=0 giving dp1=dp0=0, matching current. dp0[u] must be fully accumulated before adding, so compute dp1 after the loop. long arithmetic preserved.
